summary: Enhance your team's harmony with this training course on resolving conflicts and disputes. Learn effective strategies to foster collaboration and communication.
lede: Team conflict resolution is the practice of identifying and addressing disagreements within a professional group. For HR professionals, managers, project leads and facilitators, the course focuses on disputes that disrupt collaboration and workflow. It covers conflict-style assessment, interest-based problem solving, mediation and structured dialogue, with practice in creating team communication protocols and dispute escalation processes.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for those responsible for maintaining team cohesion and operational output in complex environments.
modules: Conflict in Remote and Hybrid Environments
prerequisites: This course is designed for professionals in leadership or support roles. While there are no formal prerequisites, participants should have at least two years of experience managing teams or working in cross-functional environments. Familiarity with basic performance management concepts and organizational communication workflows will be beneficial for the advanced mediation simulations.
